name: Rambler Dorothea

intro.text: I am doing the Cotswold Way, a hundred miles from Chipping Campden to Bath. Pause, fight, resume, in that order.

win: Not bad. Lunch time, I think. There's a pub at Broadway with scones.
after: The Cotswold Way starts at Chipping Campden, runs along the western scarp over Broadway Hill and ends at Bath Abbey. About a hundred miles. Most people take a week, and most people take a taxi for the last bit.
